not_added_flag.item: DBL Chengo 'Claro' wrapper variant (Mac filename: DBL_Cheng-Clar_Box-Open_01.jpg)
not_added_flag.issue: Every source found for Chengo's official May 2025 PCA launch (halfwheel, Cigar Journal, Cigar Inspector, Stogie Press - all covering the same release) lists only TWO wrapper options: Habano and Maduro. No source mentions a Claro, Connecticut, or Natural Chengo variant. Could not confirm what 'Clar' refers to. Candidate theories, none confirmed: (1) a third Chengo wrapper variant not yet covered in press, possibly a later/limited release; (2) a mislabeling in the filename, since the Habano wrapper can appear lighter/claro-ish in photos; (3) 'Clar' could refer to something other than wrapper color entirely (a vitola or finish name). NOT published as a confirmed wrapper variant - recommend cross-checking the actual photographed box/band against this filename.
